title: Champaign-Urbana Adventures in Time and Space
specs: Games test wits, bravery, and teamwork
Includes theatrical lighting, performer interactions, fog effects, and darker areas in some games
Recommended minimum age 7; games designed for adult difficulty
Children 7-12 can participate as part of a team; young teens without adults may find games difficult
Recommended age 13+ for Revenge of the Cabin
Games are private for your own party only
Large groups (25+) can inquire about special arrangements for corporate or school events

options.detail: Digital escape rooms playable from home, unlimited players

variants.label: Digital escape rooms playable from home, unlimited players

includes: Private game for your own party
blurb: Guests play private real life puzzle games where teams find clues, solve riddles, discover secret passages, and save the world. Most games last 60 minutes, with one game lasting 75 minutes. Games are designed for adult difficulty but children 7 and older can participate as part of a team.
extraNote: All games are private; no playing with strangers · Reservations required for all bookings · Minimum 4 players required for some games: Calling All Villains, Game Night, Rise of the Icarus, The Forest of Fables · No locking in players; goal is to save the world, not escape · Group discounts generally not offered except for large groups (25+) booking multiple rooms
